{{Quote|I went to one of the Meetings out in deepspace, halfway from the Pits of Plooma to the Galactic Rim.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], recalling a smuggling mission to [[Revyia]]|<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
The '''Pits of Plooma''' was a deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] formation in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once went past there while delivering [[rock ivory]] to [[Grambo]].<ref name="CotJ" /> The Pits were a subject of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] during their heyday.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
